PaJK Unrest Spreads to Muzaffarabad; 2 Killed in Fresh Clashes
results.description: Escalating unrest in Pakistan-administered Jammu and Kashmir spread from Rawalakot to the capital Muzaffarabad on Friday, leaving at least two people dead and deepening one of the region’s most serious political crises in years. Supporters of the banned Joint Awami Action Committee clashed with police after Friday prayers, blocking roads, burning political banners and facing tear gas. Authorities reported injuries on both sides and partial communication disruptions, while the turmoil cast a shadow over phased Legislative Assembly elections. The death of veteran activist Commander Sardar Muhammad Farooq Khan, wounded in earlier clashes, further galvanised protesters as officials insisted their crackdown and security measures were essential to safeguard law and order and the electoral process.
